title: Golden Hour tour for the best photos!
text:
Victoria was great! She was knowledgeable, warm, and knew just the right spots to pull away from the crowds and share the history, the stories, and the best golden hour views.  Her love of Andalusia and her sense of humor also won us over. I would totally recommend her!
Laurel from Colorado

title: Loved it …!
text:
Carmen was an amazing tour guide 
She had such detailed knowledge of everything 
We learnt a lot 
She gave lot of recommendations for eateries and things to do 
Beautiful views - highly recommend to start the Granada trip with this tour

title: Great experience
text: Knowledgeable and friendly guide, interesting tour with lots of information and magnificent views, we enjoyed very much.

title: Vacations
text: Carmen was an excellent guide. He explained very well, he took the tour at a comfortable pace as there were many climbs up the street and stairs.

title: Excellent guide. A lot of stairs and walking but worth it.
